verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI and API docs show broad programmatic coverage of core resources — projects, databases/rows, storage/files, users, and Functions — and this is corroborated hands-on by a working CLI (appwrite-probe-5) and MCP server (appwrite-probe-6) that let LLMs and scripts drive the platform. However, there is no explicit documentation or independent confirmation asserting full 1:1 parity between every UI-only setting (e.g., billing, team/org management, advanced console configs) and the API/CLI. Missing for 10: explicit 100% UI-API parity statement, evidence covering console-only administrative features, and independent verification of edge-case parity gaps.
